author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Yellowstone to Yukon Conservation Initiative is proudly nominated for Prince William's Earthshot Prize in 2026. This groundbreaking effort aims to reinstate a vital 3,400-kilometre wildlife corridor through the majestic Rocky Mountains. Achieving over 200 wildlife crossings and safeguarding around 24 million hectares, Indigenous involvement is key to strengthening conservation practices here. Looking forward, the initiative hopes to secure an extra 20 million hectares by 2030.
title: Yellowstone-to-Yukon project builds 204 crossings, saves 24M hectares

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: California state officials secured 640 acres of desert land near Pioneertown for western Joshua tree conservation. Researchers identified this land as suitable for the species despite climate change. The California Department of Fish and Wildlife completed the acquisition with funds from the Western Joshua Tree Conservation Fund. Collaboration with Native American tribes is planned for long-term stewardship of the property.
title: California acquires 640 acres near Pioneertown to save western Joshua trees

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Sister Stephanie Baliga once dreamed of becoming an elite runner before finding her calling as a nun. She has since used the Chicago Marathon to raise more than $2.6 million for Mission of Our Lady of the Angels, helping feed families in need. Now, she continues running and fundraising through Team OLA.
title: Ex-elite runner turned nun raises $2.6M in Chicago Marathon for families

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: In a mere 48 hours, torrential rainfall hit Uttar Pradesh, causing devastating consequences that claimed 81 lives and injured 62. The districts of Sitapur, Lakhimpur Kheri, and Bahraich faced the brunt of the disasters. Current rescue operations are focused on evaluating the extensive destruction of property and crops, while officials are mobilizing to offer support to those affected.
title: Toll soars to 81 as UP is lashed by 775% excess rainfall in 48 hours

author: ARJUMAND BANO
description: A telephonic conversation between BJP councillor Vishwajit Tripathi and Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan has gained attention online. The exchange focused on waterlogging issues during recent heavy rainfall in the city, which has not been seen in two decades. Tripathi expressed concerns regarding ineffective irrigation regulators while seeking intervention from Ravi Kishan. The MP responded by assuring him that he was monitoring the situation and prioritizing public grievances.
title: ‘Joined SP?’: Ravi Kishan’s reply after BJP councillor flags waterlogging in Gorakhpur

author: PRIYANKA DASGUPTA
description: Around thirty students and two faculty members from Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute were injured during a clash. This incident occurred when members of ABGP confronted students protesting an event at their auditorium. Injured students were treated at local hospitals, with some suffering serious injuries from the confrontation. Both sides accused the police of inaction, leading to multiple FIRs being lodged.
title: Students, faculty of Kolkata's Ray Institute hurt in clashes with RSS-linked outfit

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India captain Shubman Gill believes the best way to get the most out of Virat Kohli is to simply let the star batter be himself. Kohli smashed an unbeaten 139 off 88 balls as India beat West Indies by eight wickets in the first ODI at the Greenfield International Stadium on Sunday. Gill also scored 110 as the two shared a 151-run partnership.
title: 'He is playing with freedom': Shubman Gill on Virat Kohli's new approach

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: India boasts a variety of extraordinary train journeys that weave through breathtaking landscapes and diverse terrains. From majestic mountains to serene valleys, each trip reveals unique attractions along the way. Iconic routes such as the Nilgiri Mountain Railway and the lavish Palace On Wheels showcase India's regal heritage. These scenic journeys not only reflect the nation's rich culture and history but also captivate the hearts of adventurous travelers.
title: india's most unusual train journeys: mountains, forests, rivers, deserts

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Abhishek Sharma's 30-ball T20I hundred against Afghanistan was spectacular, but the bigger story lies in the numbers around it. The India opener is striking at 194.55 while averaging 33.18, combining extraordinary aggression with consistency. His powerplay dominance, six-hitting, record-breaking numbers and the costly downside of his approach reveal how his game has evolved.
title: Abhishek's 30-ball ton hid the number that should really worry T20 bowlers

author: IP SINGH
description: Following unsettling rumors of a student's alleged rape and suicide, Lovely Professional University witnessed violent protests. Officials quickly denied these claims, labeling them as false fabrications. In response, police launched an investigation, registering an FIR based on students' outcry. For safety reasons, classes were suspended for ten days, and mid-term exams were postponed. Students were advised to either return home or remain in their hostels until calm is restored.
title: ‘Rape-suicide’ rumour, arson, exams deferred: Key developments on LPU protests

author: RAMENDRA SINGH
description: BHEL township in Bhopal has experienced severe damage to roads due to recent monsoon rainfall. Residents are now navigating potholes, muddy stretches, and waterlogged patches daily. Commuters have reported increased vehicle breakdowns and accidents related to these conditions. While civic agencies promise repairs, residents find temporary fixes insufficient for long-term relief. There are urgent calls for comprehensive solutions to restore safety and the area's reputation.
title: Once known for tree-lined avenues, craters define these posh areas in Bhopal now

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Private equity mogul Chuck Esserman has made headlines by purchasing a lavish mansion in San Francisco for $45 million, making it the most expensive home sale in the city for 2025. Formerly owned by Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, who bought it for just $3.9 million 37 years ago, the estate boasts stunning renovations and breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge, reflecting its rich legacy.
title: $45M SF mansion linked to Ellison sells to investor after year of secrecy

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Rhode Island federal judge has ordered the revival of the $7 billion Solar for All program after the Trump administration’s EPA canceled it in August 2025. Judge Mary S. McElroy ruled the agency overstepped its authority in terminating the Biden-era initiative, which aimed to expand solar access for low-income households nationwide.
title: Judge orders revival of $7B Solar for All program, says EPA overstepped

author: TYSION PRABHU
description: On Sunday morning, a police head constable in Coimbatore prevented smugglers from escaping with gutka products. The chase began after police attempted to stop an SUV carrying over 100kg of contraband. During the pursuit, the constable clung to the top of the vehicle for nearly 40km. Ultimately, a highway patrol team intercepted the SUV and arrested three smugglers. Officials commended the constable's bravery for his actions during the incident.
title: Trapped hand, speeding SUV and desperate climb: How cops stopped gutka-laden vehicle

author: VENKADESAN S
description: Tamil Nadu's government has retracted its Sept 21 general order regarding RTI Act exemptions for law and order. The order aimed to classify law enforcement as an intelligence body, exempting it from transparency laws. Minister C T R Nirmal Kumar's explanation did not mitigate the public outcry and criticism. The order would have restricted access to important information regarding custodial deaths and police violence.
title: Amid backlash, Tamil Nadu govt revokes RTI exemption
